rows.text_en: Ministry of Education (Teacher Training and Development Division), 044-203-6508
Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「유아교육법」ㆍ「초ㆍ중등교육법」 및 「교원자격검정령」에 따른 교원자격검정의 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 1999. 1. 29., 2006. 4. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters necessary for the implementation of teacher qualification examinations pursuant to the Early Childhood Education Act, the Elementary and Secondary Education Act, and the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations . <Amended Jan. 29, 1999; Apr. 12, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(자격증의 서식 및 표시과목) ①「교원자격검정령」(이하 “검정령”이라 한다) 제3조제1항에 따라 교육감 또는 대학ㆍ산업대학ㆍ교육대학ㆍ방송통신대학ㆍ국군간호사관학교 및 전문대학의 장(이하 “대학의 장”이라 한다)이 교원자격검정에 합격한 자에 대하여 수여하는 교원자격증(이하 “자격증”이라 한다)은 별지 제1호서식과 같다. <개정 1991. 3. 16., 2001. 1. 31., 2004. 9. 3., 2006. 4. 12.>
rows.text_en: ① The teacher's certificate (hereinafter referred to as the “Certificate”) conferred by the Superintendent of Education or the head of a university, industrial university, college of education, distance learning university, Armed Forces Nursing Academy, or junior college (hereinafter referred to as the “Head of the University”) upon a person who has passed the teacher's qualification examination pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form. <Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Jan. 31, 2001; Sep. 3, 2004; Apr. 12, 2006>

rows.source_ko: ②중등학교 및 특수학교의 정교사 및 준교사의 자격증에 표시할 담당과목과 검정령 제4조제5항의 규정에 의한 초등학교의 정교사의 자격증에 표시할 담당과목은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 1999. 6. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② The subjects to be indicated on the certificates of regular and associate teachers of secondary and special schools, and the subjects to be indicated on the certificates of regular elementary school teachers pursuant to the provisions of Article 4, Paragraph 5 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations , are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended June 19, 1999>

rows.source_ko: ③실기교사의 자격증에 표시할 담당과목은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The subjects to be indicated on the practical skills teacher's certificate are as shown in Appendix 2 .

Article 3 (Method of Indicating Subjects) The method of indicating subjects assigned pursuant to Article 2 , Paragraphs 2 and 3 is as follows. <Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Sep. 26, 1994; Jan. 29, 1999; Jun. 1, 2000; Jan. 31, 2001; Sep. 3, 2004; Apr. 12, 2006; Mar. 4, 2008; Nov. 21, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대학ㆍ산업대학ㆍ방송통신대학ㆍ국군간호사관학교ㆍ전문대학(이와 동등 이상의 각종 학교를 포함한다. 이하 같다) 및 고등기술학교 전공과의 졸업자와 교육대학원(교육부장관이 지정하는 대학원의 교육과를 포함한다. 이하 같다)에서 석사학위를 받은 자가 무시험검정에 의하여 자격증을 취득하는 경우의 표시과목은 그가 전공한 학과(학부 및 전공분야를 포함한다. 이하 같다)와 관련되는 담당과목을 표시한다.
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where a graduate of a major at a university, industrial university, open university, Armed Forces Nursing Academy, junior college (including various schools of equivalent or higher status; hereinafter the same applies) and a person who has obtained a master's degree from a graduate school of education (including the education department of a graduate school designated by the Minister of Education; hereinafter the same applies) obtains a certificate through examination without examination, the subject indicated shall be the subject in charge related to the department in which he/she majored (including undergraduate and major fields; hereinafter the same applies).

rows.source_ko: 2. 임시교원양성기관을 수료한 자로서 무시험검정에 의하여 자격증을 취득하는 경우의 표시과목은 그가 이수한 과목을 표시한다.
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of a person who has completed a temporary teacher training institution and obtains a certificate through a non-examination assessment, the subject indicated shall be the subject he/she has completed.

rows.source_ko: 3. 중등학교 및 특수학교의 교사 또는 실기교사의 시험검정에 의하여 자격증을 취득하는 경우의 표시과목은 그가 시험검정에 합격한 과목을 표시한다.
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of obtaining a certificate through examination for teachers or practical teachers of secondary and special schools, the subject indicated shall be the subject for which he/she passed the examination.

rows.source_ko: 4. 교육대학 또는 전문대학의 교원으로서 무시험검정으로 자격증을 취득하는 경우의 표시과목은 해당 교원이 교육대학 또는 전문대학에서 담당한 과목을 표시하되, 그 과목을 표시하기가 곤란할 때에는 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 표시한다.
rows.text_en: 4. In the case of obtaining a qualification certificate through non-examination as a teacher at a college of education or a junior college, the subject to be indicated shall be the subject taught by the teacher at the college of education or junior college; however, if it is difficult to indicate the subject, it shall be indicated in accordance with the provisions of the Minister of Education.

rows.source_ko: 5. 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 별표 2에 따른 보수교육을 이수하여 자격증을 취득하는 경우의 표시과목은 그가 보수교육에서 이수한 과목을 표시한다.
rows.text_en: 5. In the case of obtaining a certificate by completing continuing education pursuant to Annex 2 of the “Elementary and Secondary Education Act,” the subject indicated shall be the subject he completed in the continuing education.

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(자격증 발급대장 작성등) ①교육감 및 대학의 장은 별지 제1호의2서식의 교원자격증발급대장을 작성ㆍ비치하고 자격증 발급사항을 기록ㆍ보존하여야 한다. <개정 1992. 2. 18., 1999. 1. 29., 2004. 9. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Preparation of Certificate Issuance Register, etc.) ① The Superintendent of Education and the heads of universities shall prepare and maintain a Teacher Certificate Issuance Register in accordance with Form No. 1-2 of the Attached Form, and record and preserve details of certificate issuance. <Amended Feb. 18, 1992; Jan. 29, 1999; Sep. 3, 2004>

rows.source_ko: ②교육감 및 대학의 장은 자격증발급일부터 20일 이내에 별지 제1호의3서식의 교원자격증발급자명부를 교육정보시스템으로 작성하여 관리하고, 교육부장관이 필요하다고 인정하여 제출을 요구하는 경우에는 교원자격증발급자명부를 교육부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2006. 4. 12., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Superintendent of Education and the head of a university shall prepare and manage the List of Certificate Holders in accordance with Form No. 1-3 of the Attached Form within 20 days from the date of issuance of the certificate through the Education Information System, and shall submit the List of Certificate Holders to the Minister of Education if the Minister of Education deems it necessary and requests its submission. <Amended Apr. 12, 2006; Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>
[This Article was newly established on September 27, 1988.]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(자격취소처분의 신청) 대학의 장은 해당 대학에서 자격증을 수여한 사람이 「유아교육법」 제22조의5제1항 각 호의 어느 하나 또는 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 제21조의5제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 그 대학이 소재하는 시ㆍ도의 교육감에게 해당 자격의 취소처분을 신청해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Revocation of Qualification) If a person to whom a university has awarded a qualification falls under any of the subparagraphs of Article 22-5, Paragraph 1 of the Early Childhood Education Act or Article 21-5, Paragraph 1 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act, the head of the university shall apply to the Superintendent of Education of the city or province where the university is located for the revocation of the qualification.
[Wholly Amended Jan. 23, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제5조(자격취소처분의 통지) 교육감은 제4조에 따른 신청에 따라 자격취소처분을 한 때에는 본인에게 그 사실을 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Notice of Disposition of Revocation of Qualification) When the Superintendent of Education has issued a disposition of revocation of qualification pursuant to an application under Article 4, he/she shall notify the person concerned of such fact.
[Wholly Amended Jan. 23, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(자격증 재교부 신청) 검정령 제7조의 규정에 의하여 자격증의 재교부를 받고자 하는 자는 별지 제2호서식의 교원자격증재교부신청서를 교육감 또는 교원자격검정을 한 대학의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 1991. 3. 16., 2001. 1. 31., 2004. 9. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Application for Reissuance of Certificate) Any person who wishes to receive a reissuance of a certificate pursuant to the provisions of Article 7 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations shall submit an Application for Reissuance of Teacher Certificate (Form No. 2) to the Superintendent of Education or the head of the university that conducted the teacher qualification examination. <Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Jan. 31, 2001; Sep. 3, 2004>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(자격증 기재사항 정정신청) 검정령 제7조의 규정에 의하여 자격증의 기재사항을 정정받고자 하는 자는 별지 제3호서식의 교원자격증기재사항정정신청서를 교육감 또는 교원자격검정을 한 대학의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 1991. 3. 16., 1999. 1. 29., 2001. 1. 31., 2004. 9. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Correction of Details on Certificate) Any person who wishes to have the details on a certificate corrected pursuant to the provisions of Article 7 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations shall submit the Application for Correction of Details on Teacher Certificate (Form No. 3) to the Superintendent of Education or the head of the university that conducted the teacher qualification examination. <Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Jan. 29, 1999; Jan. 31, 2001; Sep. 3, 2004>
1. Deleted <January 29, 1999>
2. Deleted <January 29, 1999>

rows.source_ko: 제7조의2(외국의 교육기관 근무경력범위) 교육부장관은 검정령 제8조제1항제4호의 규정에 의하여 외국의 교육기관에서 근무한 경력을 교육경력으로 인정하는 때에는 다음 각호의 1의 범위안에서 행하여야 한다. <개정 2001. 1. 31., 2002. 9. 10., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Scope of Work Experience at Foreign Educational Institutions) When the Minister of Education recognizes work experience at a foreign educational institution as educational experience pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations, such recognition shall be made within the scope of any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 31, 2001; Sep. 10, 2002; Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 외국어계열 고등학교의 교장자격인정의 경우에는 외국의 학교에서 전임 교직원으로 근무한 경력
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of principal qualification recognition for foreign language high schools, experience working as a full-time school staff member at a foreign school

rows.source_ko: 2. 외국어계열 고등학교외의 학교의 교장 또는 원장자격인정의 경우에는 외국의 교육기관에서 전임으로 근무한 경력
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of qualification recognition for a principal or director of a school other than a foreign language high school, full-time work experience at a foreign educational institution
[This Article was newly established on June 1, 2000.]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(수수료) 검정령 제11조의 규정에 의한 수수료는 별표 6과 같다. <개정 2011. 4. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Fees) The fees pursuant to Article 11 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations are as set forth in Attached Table 6. <Amended Apr. 4, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 제8조의2(전자민원창구의 설치ㆍ운영) 교육감 및 대학의 장은 자격증의 교부 등과 관련하여 민원인이 해당 기관을 방문하지 아니하고도 민원사항 등을 처리할 수 있도록 전자민원창구를 설치ㆍ운영할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 8-2 (Establishment and Operation of Electronic Civil Petition Window) The Superintendent of Education and the head of a university may establish and operate an electronic civil petition window so that petitioners can process civil petition matters, etc., without visiting the relevant institution in relation to the issuance of certificates, etc.
[This Article Newly Inserted April 4, 2011]
Chapter 2 Examination-Free Certification

rows.source_ko: 제9조(무시험검정의 신청) ①상급자격증 또는 그 밖의 자격증 취득을 위한 자격연수과정을 이수하고 교원자격무시험검정을 받으려는 사람은 별지 제4호서식의 교원자격무시험검정원서(이하 “무시험검정원서”라 한다)에 「유아교육법」 제22조의2제1호 또는 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 제21조의2제1호에 따른 마약ㆍ대마ㆍ향정신성의약품 중독자가 아님을 증명하는 의사의 진단서 또는 건강검진 결과통보서를 첨부(단서의 경우를 포함한다)하여 교육감에게 제출해야 한다. 다만, 해당 자격연수과정을 주관한 연수기관의 장이 별지 제5호서식의 자격연수이수자명단을 교육감에게 제출한 경우에는 해당 자격연수과정이수자가 무시험검정원서를 제출한 것으로 본다. <개정 2021. 6. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Application for Examination Without Examination) ① A person who has completed a qualification training course for acquiring a higher-level qualification certificate or other qualification certificate and wishes to undergo the teacher qualification examination without examination shall submit to the Superintendent of Education an Application for Teacher Qualification Examination Without Examination (Form No. 4, hereinafter referred to as the “Application Without Examination”) attached (including cases under the proviso) a medical certificate from a physician or a notification of health examination results proving that the person is not an addict of narcotics, cannabis, or psychotropic drugs pursuant to Article 22-2 , Subparagraph 1 of the Early Childhood Education Act or Article 21-2, Subparagraph 1 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act. However, if the head of the training institution that organized the relevant qualification training course submits the List of Qualification Training Completers (Form No. 5) to the Superintendent of Education, the completer of the relevant qualification training course shall be deemed to have submitted the Application Without Examination. <Amended June 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ②대학ㆍ산업대학ㆍ교육대학ㆍ방송통신대학ㆍ국군간호사관학교 및 전문대학 졸업자 또는 졸업예정자와 교육대학원에서 석사학위를 취득한 사람 또는 학위취득이 확정된 사람으로서 무시험검정을 받으려는 사람은 무시험검정원서에 「유아교육법」 제22조의2제1호 또는 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 제21조의2제1호에 따른 마약ㆍ대마ㆍ향정신성의약품 중독자가 아님을 증명하는 의사의 진단서 또는 건강검진 결과통보서를 첨부하여 해당 대학의 장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 1988. 9. 27., 1999. 1. 29., 2004. 9. 3., 2006. 4. 12., 2017. 8. 17., 2021. 6. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Graduates or prospective graduates of universities, industrial universities, colleges of education, distance learning universities, the Armed Forces Nursing Academy, and junior colleges, as well as persons who have obtained a master's degree from a graduate school of education or whose degree acquisition has been confirmed, and who wish to undergo examination-free certification, shall submit an application for examination-free certification to the head of the relevant university, attaching a medical certificate from a physician or a notification of health examination results certifying that they are not addicts of narcotics, cannabis, or psychotropic drugs pursuant to Article 22-2 , Subparagraph 1 of the Early Childhood Education Act or Article 21-2, Subparagraph 1 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act. <Amended Sep. 27, 1988; Jan. 29, 1999; Sep. 3, 2004; Apr. 12, 2006; Aug. 17, 2017; Jun. 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 무시험검정원서를 제출받은 대학의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 서류 사본을 첨부하도록 하여야 한다. <신설 2017. 8. 17.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the university receiving an application for examination without examination pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall verify the documents classified according to the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach copies of the documents specified in the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Aug. 17, 2017>
1. Health Teacher Certification Without Examination: Nursing License
2. Nutrition Teacher Examination-Free Certification: Dietitian License
3. Examination-free certification for practical instructors: National technical qualification certificates (limited to relevant subjects)

rows.source_ko: ④「유아교육법」 별표 1 및 같은 법 시행령 제34조에 따라 원장의 자격인정을 받으려는 사람 및 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 별표 1 및 같은 법 시행령 제106조의2에 따라 교장의 자격인정을 받으려는 사람은 별지 제7호서식의 교장(원장)자격인정검정원서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 교육감에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 1985. 1. 25., 1991. 3. 16., 2000. 6. 1., 2006. 4. 12., 2021. 6. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ Persons who intend to obtain recognition of qualification as a Director pursuant to Annex 1 of the Early Childhood Education Act and Article 34 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and persons who intend to obtain recognition of qualification as a Principal pursuant to Annex 1 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act and Article 106-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, shall submit to the Superintendent of Education the Application for Examination for Recognition of Principal (Director) Qualification in the Attached Form No. 7, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 25, 1985; Mar. 16, 1991; Jun. 1, 2000; Apr. 12, 2006; Jun. 23, 2021>
1. Personal Information Statement in Form No. 7-2

rows.source_ko: 2. 인사기록카드 사본(공무원 또는 사립학교교원으로 재직하고 있거나 재직한 경력이 있는 사람의 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Copy of personnel record card (limited to persons currently employed or with a history of employment as a public official or private school teacher)
3. Deleted <December 9, 1997>

rows.source_ko: ⑤제1항부터 제4항까지에 규정된 사람 외의 사람으로서 무시험검정을 받으려는 사람은 무시험검정원서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 교육감에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 1988. 9. 27., 1997. 12. 9., 2021. 6. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Any person other than those specified in Paragraphs 1 through 4 who wishes to undergo examination without examination shall submit an application for examination without examination to the Superintendent of Education, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 27, 1988; Dec. 9, 1997; Jun. 23, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 졸업 또는 수료증명서(졸업 또는 수료를 교원자격요건으로 하는 경우에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Certificate of Graduation or Completion (only applicable where graduation or completion is a requirement for teacher qualification)

rows.source_ko: 2. 경력증명서(일정한 경력을 교원자격요건으로 하는 경우에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Certificate of Work Experience (limited to cases where certain work experience is a requirement for teaching qualification)

rows.source_ko: 3. 「유아교육법」 제22조의2제1호 또는 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 제21조의2제1호에 따른 마약ㆍ대마ㆍ향정신성의약품 중독자가 아님을 증명하는 의사의 진단서 또는 건강검진 결과통보서
rows.text_en: 3. A medical certificate or health examination result report proving that the individual is not addicted to narcotics, cannabis, or psychotropic drugs pursuant to Article 22-2, Subparagraph 1 of the Early Childhood Education Act or Article 21-2, Subparagraph 1 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act

rows.source_ko: ⑥제2항의 규정에 의한 무시험검정원서를 받은 당해대학의 장은 별지 제7호의3서식의 교원자격무시험검정신청자명부를 작성ㆍ비치하여야 한다. <신설 1988. 9. 27.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The head of the relevant university who has received an application for examination without examination pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 2 shall prepare and maintain a list of applicants for teacher qualification examination without examination in the form of Annex 7-3 . <Newly added Sep. 27, 1988>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 교육감 및 대학의 장은 제1항, 제2항, 제4항 및 제5항에 따라 무시험검정을 신청한 사람이 「유아교육법」 제22조의2제2호ㆍ제3호 및 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 제21조의2제2호ㆍ제3호에 따른 범죄의 경력이 있는지 조회해 줄 것을 국가경찰관서의 장에게 요청(「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통한 조회 요청을 포함한다)하여야 한다. <신설 2022. 12. 13.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Superintendent of Education and the head of a university shall request the head of a national police agency to check whether a person who has applied for examination-free certification pursuant to Paragraphs 1, 2, 4, and 5 has a criminal record pursuant to Article 22-2, Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the Early Childhood Education Act and Article 21-2, Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act ( including a request for inquiry through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act ). <Newly added Dec. 13, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 교육감 및 대학의 장은 제7항에 따른 조회를 요청할 때에는 해당 신청인의 동의를 받아야 하며, 신청인이 조회에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 성범죄 경력 조회 회신서를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다. <신설 2022. 12. 13.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ When the Superintendent of Education and the head of a university request an inquiry pursuant to Paragraph 7, they shall obtain the consent of the relevant applicant; if the applicant does not consent to the inquiry, they shall require the attachment of a response letter regarding the sex offense history check. <Newly added Dec. 13, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(교육장의 경유) 교육감은 검정사무의 원활한 처리를 위하여 필요하다고 인정할 때에는 제9조제1항의 규정에 의한 무시험검정서류 및 동조제4항의 규정에 의한 교장(원장)자격인정검정서류를 관할교육장을 거쳐 제출하게 할 수 있다. <개정 1992. 2. 18., 2000. 6. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Submission through the Head of a District Education Office) When the Superintendent of Education deems it necessary for the smooth processing of examination affairs, he/she may require the submission of documents for examination without examination pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 1 , and documents for the examination for the recognition of principal (or director) qualification pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 4 of the same Article, through the competent head of a district education office. <Amended Feb. 18, 1992; June 1, 2000>
[Title amended Feb. 18, 1992]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(교직과정의 설치기준) 검정령 제20조제2항의 규정에 의하여 교직과정의 설치기준을 다음과 같이 한다. <개정 1996. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Standards for Establishment of Teacher Training Programs) Pursuant to the provisions of Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations, the standards for the establishment of teacher training programs shall be as follows. <Amended Aug. 30, 1996>
1. There must be at least two full-time faculty members in charge of the teacher training program.

rows.source_ko: 2. 당해교직과정의 설치목적에 따른 교육실습을 위하여 병설 또는 협력하는 고등학교, 중학교, 특수학교, 초등학교 또는 유치원을 두어야 한다.
rows.text_en: 2. A high school, middle school, special school, elementary school, or kindergarten must be established in conjunction with or cooperate for educational practice in accordance with the purpose of establishing the relevant teacher training course.

rows.source_ko: 제12조(전공과목 및 교직과목의 이수기준과 학점 등) ① 검정령 제4조제3항과 별표 1 제1호가목 및 마목에 따른 자격종별 전공과목 및 교직과목의 세부 이수분야 및 이수학점은 별표 3과 같다. 다만, 교사자격종별ㆍ표시과목별 기본이수과목 및 교직과목의 과목별 이수학점은 교육부장관이 정한다. <개정 2008. 3. 4., 2012. 11. 21., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Standards for Completion and Credits, etc., of Major and Teaching Subjects) ①The detailed fields of completion and credits for major and teaching subjects by qualification type, pursuant to Article 4 , Paragraph 3 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations and Subparagraphs 1(a) and 1(e) of Annex 1, are as set forth in Annex 3. However, the credits required for each subject of basic subjects and teaching subjects by teacher qualification type and subject designation shall be determined by the Minister of Education. <Amended Mar. 4, 2008; Nov. 21, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② 검정령 제19조제4항에 따른 자격종별 합격기준은 다음 각 호의 사항에 관하여 교원양성기관의 장이 정하는 기준으로 한다. <개정 2012. 11. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② The passing criteria for each type of qualification pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 4 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations shall be the standards determined by the head of the teacher training institution regarding the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Nov. 21, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 1. 외국어 표시과목 해당자의 경우 일정 수준의 외국어 구사능력
rows.text_en: 1. For those taking foreign language subjects, a certain level of foreign language proficiency

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 교원양성기관의 장이 자격종별 특성을 고려할 때 필요하다고 인정하는 기준
rows.text_en: 2. Other standards deemed necessary by the head of the teacher training institution in consideration of the characteristics of each qualification type

rows.source_ko: ③ 검정령 별표 1 제1호다목에 따라 전문상담교사양성과정에서 이수하여야 할 과목과 학점은 별표 4와 같다. <신설 2012. 11. 21.>
rows.text_en: ③ The subjects and credits to be completed in the Professional Counseling Teacher Training Course pursuant to Item 1, Subparagraph (c) of Annex 1 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations are as set forth in Annex 4. <Newly added Nov. 21, 2012>

rows.source_ko: ④ 검정령 별표 1 제1호라목에 따라 영양교육과정에서 이수하여야 할 과목과 학점은 별표 4의2와 같다. <신설 2012. 11. 21.>
rows.text_en: ④ The subjects and credits to be completed in the nutrition education curriculum pursuant to Item 1, Subparagraph (d) of Annex 1 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations are as set forth in Annex 4-2 . <Newly added Nov. 21, 2012>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 검정령 별표 1 제1호바목에 따른 교직과목의 세부 이수 분야는 교직이론과 교직소양으로 하며, 각 분야의 세부 과목은 교육부장관이 정한다. <신설 2012. 1. 13., 2012. 11. 21., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The detailed fields of completion for teaching subjects pursuant to Subparagraph 1, Item (f) of Annex 1 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations shall be teaching theory and teaching aptitude, and the detailed subjects for each field shall be determined by the Minister of Education. <Newly added Jan. 13, 2012; Nov. 21, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 2007]
Article 12-2 Deleted <2012. 11. 21.>
Article 12-3 Deleted <2012. 11. 21.>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(학과 및 기본이수영역) ①대학 또는 전문대학의 졸업이나 석사학위 취득을 요건으로 무시험검정에 의하여 자격증을 취득할 수 있는 표시과목의 관련 학과와 그 기본이수영역은 교육부장관이 정한다. 이 경우 중등학교 정교사(2급) 담당과목의 표시과목중 공업에 관한 표시과목의 무시험검정을 받고자 하는 자는 「직업교육훈련 촉진법」 제7조의 규정에 의한 산업체현장실습을 4주이상 이수한 자이어야 한다. <개정 1991. 3. 16., 1994. 9. 26., 1999. 1. 29., 2000. 1. 28., 2000. 6. 1., 2001. 1. 31., 2006. 4. 12., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Departments and Basic Completion Areas) ① The relevant departments and basic completion areas of designation subjects for which a certificate can be obtained through examination without examination, provided that graduation from a university or junior college or the acquisition of a master's degree is a requirement, shall be determined by the Minister of Education. In this case, a person who wishes to undergo examination without examination for an industrial designation subject among the subjects taught by a secondary school regular teacher (Level 2) must be a person who has completed at least 4 weeks of on-the-job training at an industrial site pursuant to Article 7 of the Vocational Education and Training Promotion Act . <Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Sep. 26, 1994; Jan. 29, 1999; Jan. 28, 2000; June 1, 2000; Jan. 31, 2001; Apr. 12, 2006; Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따라 기본이수영역의 이수학점은 2급의 경우 21학점 이상, 준교사 및 실기교사의 경우 6학점 이상으로 한다. <개정 2000. 1. 28., 2007. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Paragraph 1, the required credits for the basic completion area shall be at least 21 credits for Level 2, and at least 6 credits for Assistant Teachers and Practical Skills Teachers. <Amended Jan. 28, 2000; Dec. 31, 2007>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(교직과정등의 설치신청) ①검정령 제20조제1항의 규정에 의하여 교직과정을 설치하고자 하는 학교의 장은 별지 제8호서식의 교직과정설치승인신청서에 다음의 서류를 첨부하여 교육부장관에게 신청하여야 한다. <개정 1991. 3. 16., 1992. 2. 18., 2000. 1. 28., 2001. 1. 31., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Application for Establishment of Teacher Training Courses, etc.) ①The head of a school who intends to establish a teacher training course pursuant to the provisions of Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations shall apply to the Minister of Education by attaching the following documents to the Application for Approval of Establishment of a Teacher Training Course in the form of Annex 8. <Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Feb. 18, 1992; Jan. 28, 2000; Jan. 31, 2001; Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>
1. Curriculum Organization Table of Departments with Teacher Training Programs
2. List of full-time faculty members in charge of the teacher training program

rows.source_ko: 3. 교육실습을 위한 병설학교의 설치 또는 교육실습을 행할 학교와 실습에 관하여 협의가 이루어졌음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving that an agreement has been reached regarding the establishment of an affiliated school for educational practice or the practice with the school where the practice will be conducted.

rows.source_ko: ② 대학ㆍ산업대학 및 교육대학의 장 또는 시ㆍ도교육감이 검정령 제20조제3항에 따라 교직과정 외에 자격증 취득을 위한 교육ㆍ연수과정을 개설하려는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 교육부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <신설 2012. 11. 21., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Where the head of a university, industrial university, or college of education, or the Superintendent of Education of a City or Province intends to establish an education or training course for the acquisition of a certificate other than the teaching course pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Decree on Teacher Qualification Examinations, they shall submit the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Education. <Newly added Nov. 21, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013>
1. Education and Training Course Operation Plan
2. Education and Training Course Schedule

rows.source_ko: ③「초ㆍ중등교육법」 별표 2 전문상담교사(1급) 자격기준 제1호 및 전문상담교사(2급) 자격기준 제3호에 따라 전문상담교사양성과정을 설치하고자 하는 학교의 장은 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 전문상담교사양성과정의 설치지정을 교육부장관에게 신청하여야 한다. <신설 1999. 1. 29., 2001. 1. 31., 2004. 9. 3., 2006. 4. 12., 2008. 3. 4., 2012. 11. 21., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of a school who intends to establish a professional counseling teacher training course pursuant to Subparagraph 1 of the qualification standards for Professional Counseling Teachers (Level 1) and Subparagraph 3 of the qualification standards for Professional Counseling Teachers (Level 2) in Annex 2 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act shall apply to the Minister of Education for the designation of the establishment of the professional counseling teacher training course by attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Jan. 29, 1999; Jan. 31, 2001; Sep. 3, 2004; Apr. 12, 2006; Mar. 4, 2008; Nov. 21, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013>
1. Curriculum Organization Table of Departments with Professional Counseling Teacher Training Programs
2. List of full-time faculty members in charge of the Professional Counseling Teacher Training Program

rows.source_ko: ④법률 제7068호 초ㆍ중등교육법중개정법률 부칙 제3조의 규정에 의하여 영양교육과정을 설치하고자 하는 학교의 장은 다음 각호의 서류를 첨부하여 1년과정ㆍ2년과정별로 영양교육과정의 설치지정을 교육부장관에게 신청하여야 한다. <신설 2004. 9. 3., 2008. 3. 4., 2012. 11. 21., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ Pursuant to the provisions of Article 3 of the Addenda to the Act Amending the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (Act No. 7068), the head of a school intending to establish a nutrition education curriculum shall apply to the Minister of Education for the designation of the establishment of a nutrition education curriculum for each one-year and two-year course, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Sep. 3, 2004; Mar. 4, 2008; Nov. 21, 2012; Mar. 23, 2013>
1. Curriculum Organization Table of Departments with Nutrition Education Programs
2. List of full-time faculty members in charge of the nutrition education curriculum
[Title amended Jan. 29, 1999]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(교직과정이수예정자의 선발) ①교직과정을 이수하고자 하는 자는 제2학년중에 학교의 장에게 교직과정이수신청을 하여야 하며, 학교의 장은 교직과정신청자중 인성, 적성 및 성적등을 고려하여 당해학년의 학과별입학정원의 30퍼센트 범위 안에서 선발하여 교직과정을 이수하게 하여야 한다. <개정 1983. 10. 5., 1992. 2. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Selection of Prospective Students for Teacher Training Course) ① Those who wish to complete the teacher training course shall apply to the head of the school during their second year. The head of the school shall select students from among the applicants within 30 percent of the departmental admission quota for the relevant academic year, taking into consideration character, aptitude, academic performance, etc., and allow them to complete the teacher training course. <Amended Oct. 5, 1983; Feb. 18, 1992>
② Deleted <January 29, 1999>

rows.source_ko: ③제1항의 규정에 의한 교직과정이수예정자의 선발비율은 교원수급상 필요할 때에는 교육부장관이 자격종별 및 과목별로 이를 조정할 수 있다. <개정 1991. 3. 16., 2001. 1. 31., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Education may adjust the selection ratio of prospective teachers subject to the provisions of Paragraph 1 by qualification type and subject when necessary for the supply and demand of teachers. <Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Jan. 31, 2001; Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>
[Title amended Jan. 29, 1999]

rows.source_ko: 제16조(학교지정신청) 「유아교육법」 별표 2 및 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 별표 2의 교사자격기준에 의한 “교육부장관이 지정하는 대학 또는 대학원”으로 지정을 받고자 하는 학교의 장은 그 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 교육부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 1991. 3. 16., 1999. 1. 29., 2001. 1. 31., 2006. 4. 12., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Application for School Designation) The head of a school who wishes to be designated as a “university or graduate school designated by the Minister of Education” in accordance with the teacher qualification standards set forth in Annex 2 of the Early Childhood Education Act and Annex 2 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act shall submit an application to the Minister of Education, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs.<Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Jan. 29, 1999; Jan. 31, 2001; Apr. 12, 2006; Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>
1. Curriculum organization table of the department seeking designation

rows.source_ko: 2. 지정을 받고자 하는 학과의 설치 연월일 및 학생정원
rows.text_en: 2. Date of establishment and student quota of the department seeking designation
Chapter 3 Examination and Certification
Article 17 Deleted <January 13, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제18조(시험검정의 첨부서류) ① 시험검정을 받으려는 사람은 별지 제10호서식의 교원자격시험검정원서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 교육감에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2022. 12. 13.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Documents Attached to Examination and Certification) ① A person who intends to undergo examination and certification shall submit to the Superintendent of Education the Application for Teacher Qualification Examination and Certification in the form of Annex No. 10, attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 13, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「유아교육법」 제22조의2제1호 또는 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 제21조의2제1호에 따른 마약ㆍ대마ㆍ향정신성의약품 중독자가 아님을 증명하는 의사의 진단서 또는 건강검진 결과통보서
rows.text_en: 1. A medical certificate or health examination result report proving that the individual is not addicted to narcotics, cannabis, or psychotropic drugs pursuant to Article 22-2, Subparagraph 1 of the Early Childhood Education Act or Article 21-2, Subparagraph 1 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act

rows.text_en: ② The Superintendent of Education shall request the head of a national police agency to check whether a person who has applied for examination or certification pursuant to Paragraph 1 has a criminal record pursuant to Article 22-2, Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the Early Childhood Education Act and Article 21-2, Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act ( including a request for inquiry through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act ). <Newly added Dec. 13, 2022>

rows.text_en: ③ When the Superintendent of Education requests an inquiry pursuant to Paragraph 2, he/she shall obtain the consent of the relevant applicant; if the applicant does not consent to the inquiry, the applicant shall be required to attach a response letter regarding the sex offender history check. <Newly added Dec. 13, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제19조(시험검정의 시행) 시험검정을 실시하고자 할 때에는 시험의 일시ㆍ장소ㆍ응시자격등을 정하여 적어도 시험시행 30일 전에 이를 공고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Implementation of Examination) When conducting an examination, the date, time, place, and qualifications for the examination, etc., shall be determined and announced at least 30 days prior to the examination.

rows.source_ko: 제20조(학력고사 과목) ①중등학교 및 특수학교준교사의 자격시험검정의 학력고사과목은 별표 1의 표시과목중 그가 담당할 과목 및 교육학으로 한다. <개정 1993. 2. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Subjects of the Academic Achievement Test) ① The subjects of the academic achievement test for the qualification examination of assistant teachers in secondary and special schools shall be the subjects he/she is to teach among the subjects indicated in Attached Table 1 , and pedagogy. <Amended Feb. 6, 1993>

rows.source_ko: ②실기교사자격시험검정의 학력고사과목은 별표 2의 표시과목중 그가 담당할 과목 및 교육학으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The subjects for the academic achievement test for the practical skills teacher qualification examination shall be the subjects he/she is responsible for among the subjects indicated in Appendix 2 and pedagogy.

rows.source_ko: ③초등학교준교사자격시험검정의 학력고사과목은 도덕ㆍ국어ㆍ수학ㆍ사회ㆍ과학ㆍ체육ㆍ음악ㆍ미술ㆍ실과ㆍ영어 및 교육학으로 한다. <개정 1996. 8. 30., 2016. 12. 8.>
rows.text_en: ③ The subjects of the academic achievement test for the Elementary School Assistant Teacher Qualification Examination shall be Morals, Korean Language, Mathematics, Social Studies, Science, Physical Education, Music, Art, Practical Arts, English, and Pedagogy. <Amended Aug. 30, 1996; Dec. 8, 2016>

rows.source_ko: ④유치원준교사자격시험검정의 학력고사과목은 사회정서발달영역ㆍ인지발달영역ㆍ언어발달영역ㆍ신체발달영역ㆍ건강영역 및 교육학으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The subjects of the academic achievement test for the kindergarten quasi-teacher qualification examination shall be social-emotional development, cognitive development, language development, physical development, health, and pedagogy.

rows.source_ko: 제21조(시험과목의 일부면제) 시험검정응시자에게는 그 원에 의하여 별표 5와 같이 시험과목의 일부를 면제할 수 있다. <개정 1993. 2. 6., 1997. 12. 9., 1999. 1. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Partial Exemption from Examination Subjects) Upon request, some examination subjects may be exempted for an applicant for the certification exam as set forth in Attached Table 5. <Amended Feb. 6, 1993; Dec. 9, 1997; Jan. 29, 1999>

rows.source_ko: 제22조(시험의 정도와 시간) ①중등학교 및 특수학교준교사의 자격시험검정의 학력고사중 교육학과목은 교육원리ㆍ교육사ㆍ교육심리학ㆍ교육사회학 및 과목지도법의 기초영역에 대하여, 실기교사자격시험검정의 학력고사중 교육학과목은 교육학개론 및 실기교육방법론의 기초영역에 대하여 각각 60분간 실시한다. <개정 1993. 2. 6.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Examination Level and Duration) ① The subject of education in the academic achievement test for the qualification examination of assistant teachers in secondary and special schools shall be administered for 60 minutes regarding the basic areas of educational principles, history of education, educational psychology, educational sociology, and subject teaching methods; and the subject of education in the academic achievement test for the qualification examination of practical skills teachers shall be administered for 60 minutes regarding the basic areas of Introduction to Education and Methodology of Practical Education. <Amended Feb. 6, 1993>

rows.source_ko: ②중등학교 및 특수학교의 준교사와 실기교사의 자격시험검정의 전공과목은 제13조제1항의 규정에 의하여 교육부장관이 정한 기본이수영역에 대하여 120분간 실시한다. <개정 1991. 3. 16., 1993. 2. 6., 2001. 1. 31., 2008. 3. 4., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The major subjects for the qualification examination of assistant teachers and practical skills teachers in secondary and special schools shall be conducted for 120 minutes regarding the basic completion areas determined by the Minister of Education pursuant to the provisions of Article 13 , Paragraph 1. <Amended Mar. 16, 1991; Feb. 6, 1993; Jan. 31, 2001; Mar. 4, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③초등학교준교사자격시험검정의 학력고사는 교육대학졸업 정도의 수준으로 제20조제3항의 규정에 의한 전과목에 대하여 200분간 실시한다. <개정 1996. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The academic achievement test for the qualification examination for Elementary School Assistant Teachers shall be conducted for 200 minutes covering all subjects pursuant to the provisions of Article 20, Paragraph 3, at a level equivalent to a graduate of a College of Education. <Amended Aug. 30, 1996>

rows.source_ko: ④유치원준교사자격시험검정의 학력고사는 전문대학졸업정도의 수준으로 제20조제4항의 규정에 의한 전과목에 대하여 120분간 실시한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The academic achievement test for the kindergarten quasi-teacher qualification examination shall be conducted for 120 minutes for all subjects pursuant to the provisions of Article 20, Paragraph 4, at the level equivalent to a junior college graduate.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Industrial Field Training by Examination-Free Certification)  The amended provisions of Article 13, Paragraph 1 shall apply to those who enter a college of education or a university in the 1995 academic year.

rows.source_ko: 제4조 (폐지된 표시과목에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 교직과정을 이수중인 자중 별표 1 및 별표 2의 개정규정에 의하여 표시과목이 폐지된 표시과목에 해당하는 과목을 이수한 자에 대하여 자격증을 교부하는 경우에는 별표 1 및 별표 2의 개정규정에 불구하고 종전의 규정에 의한 표시과목이 표시된 자격증을 교부한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Abolished Designation Subjects)  In cases where a certificate is issued to a person who is currently undergoing a teacher training course at the time of enforcement of this rule and has completed a subject corresponding to a subject whose designation has been abolished pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 1 and Annex 2, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 1 and Annex 2, a certificate indicating the designation subject under the previous regulations shall be issued.

rows.source_ko: 제5조 (자격증의 재교부) 교육감은 부칙 제4조의 규정에 해당하는 자격증을 소지한 자가 자격증의 정정발급을 신청하는 때에는 지체없이 변경된 표시과목이 기재된 자격증을 재교부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Reissuance of Certificates)  When a person holding a certificate falling under the provisions of Article 4 of the Addenda applies for the issuance of a corrected certificate, the Superintendent of Education shall reissue the certificate with the changed subject indicated without delay.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 또는 제2항에 따라 분리되기 전 표시과목이 표시된 자격증을 소지한 사람은 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 소정의 연수를 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Persons holding a certificate with a subject indicated prior to separation pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2 must undergo prescribed training as determined by the Minister of Education.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(자격증의 정정) ① 교육부장관은 부칙 제3조제3항에 따라 연수를 받은 사람 또는 표시과목이 “상업정보”인 자격증을 소지한 사람이 자격증의 정정을 신청하는 경우에는 명칭이 변경된 표시과목으로 자격증을 정정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Correction of Certificate)  ① In the event that a person who has received training pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Addenda or a person holding a certificate with the subject designated as “Commercial Information” applies for the correction of their certificate, the Minister of Education shall correct the certificate to the subject designated with the changed name.

rows.source_ko: ② 교육부장관은 부칙 제4조제3항에 따라 연수를 받은 사람이 자격증의 정정을 신청하는 경우에는 분리된 표시과목으로 자격증을 정정하여야 한다. 이 경우 표시과목이 ‘디자인ㆍ공예’로 표시된 자격증을 소지한 자는 ‘디자인’과 ‘공예’ 중에서, 표시과목이 ‘전기ㆍ전자ㆍ통신’으로 표시된 자격증을 소지한 자는 ‘전기’, ‘전자’와 ‘통신’ 중에서, 표시과목이 ‘기계ㆍ금속’으로 표시된 자격증을 소지한 자는 ‘기계’와 ‘재료’ 중에서, 표시과목이 ‘화공ㆍ섬유’로 표시된 자격증을 소지한 자는 ‘화공’과 ‘섬유’ 중에서, 표시과목이 ‘항해ㆍ기관’으로 표시된 자격증을 소지한 자는 ‘항해’와 ‘기관’ 중에서 하나의 표시과목을 선택하여 자격증의 정정을 신청하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 4, Paragraph 3 of the Addenda, if a person who has received training applies for the correction of a certificate, the Minister of Education shall correct the certificate to a separated subject. In this case, a person holding a certificate with the subject indicated as 'Design and Crafts' must apply for the correction of the certificate by selecting one subject from among 'Design' and 'Crafts'; a person holding a certificate with the subject indicated as 'Electric, Electronic, and Communications' must select one subject from among 'Electric', 'Electronics' and 'Communications'; a person holding a certificate with the subject indicated as 'Machinery and Metals' must select one subject from among 'Machinery' and 'Materials'; a person holding a certificate with the subject indicated as 'Chemical Engineering and Textiles' must select one subject from among 'Chemical Engineering' and 'Textiles'; and a person holding a certificate with the subject indicated as 'Navigation and Marine Engines' must select one subject from among 'Navigation' and 'Marine Engines'.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(교직과목 교육실습 이수학점 기준에 관한 적용례) 별표 3의 교직과목 교육실습 이수학점 기준의 개정규정은 2018년 3월 1일 이후 대학 및 대학원에 입학(편입학을 포함한다)하는 사람부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability of Standards for Credits for Teaching Practice in Teaching Subjects)  The revised regulations regarding the standards for credits for teaching practice in teaching subjects in Appendix 3 shall apply to those who enter (including transfer students) a university or graduate school on or after March 1, 2018.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(명칭이 변경된 표시과목에 관한 경과조치) ① 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따른 표시과목 중 별표 1 및 별표 2의 개정규정에 따라 명칭이 변경되기 전 표시과목인“요업”으로 표시된 자격증은 명칭이 변경된 표시과목인“세라믹”으로 표시된 자격증으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Renamed Certificate Subjects) ① A certificate indicating “Ceramic Industry” under the former provisions at the time of enforcement of this Rule shall, pursuant to the amendments to Annexes 1 and 2, be deemed a certificate indicating the renamed subject “Ceramics”.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행 당시 교직과정을 이수 중인 사람 중 별표 1 및 별표 2의 개정규정에 따라 명칭이 변경되기 전 표시과목에 해당하는 과목을 이수한 사람에 대하여 자격증을 교부하는 경우에는 별표 1 및 별표 2의 개정규정에도 불구하고 명칭이 변경되기 전 표시과목이 표시된 자격증을 교부한다. 이 경우 교부된 자격증은 제1항에 따라 명칭이 변경된 표시과목이 표시된 자격증으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 1 and Annex 2, when issuing a certificate to a person who is currently undergoing a teacher training course at the time of the enforcement of this Rule and has completed a subject corresponding to the subject designation prior to the name change, a certificate bearing the subject designation prior to the name change shall be issued. In this case, the issued certificate shall be deemed to be a certificate bearing the subject designation with the name changed pursuant to Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(분리된 표시과목에 관한 경과조치) ① 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따른 표시과목 중 별표 1의 개정규정에 따라 분리되기 전 표시과목이 “자원ㆍ환경”으로 표시된 자격증은 표시과목이 분리된 “자원” 또는 “환경공업”으로 표시된 자격증으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Separated Designation Subjects)  ① Among the designation subjects under the former regulations at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, any certificate in which the designation subject was designated as “Resources and Environment” prior to separation in accordance with the amended regulations of Annex 1 shall be deemed to be a certificate in which the designation subject has been separated as “Resources” or “Environmental Industry.”

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행 당시 교직과정을 이수 중인 사람 중 별표 1의 개정규정에 따라 분리되기 전 표시과목에 해당하는 과목을 이수한 자에 대하여 자격증을 교부하는 경우에는 별표 1의 개정규정에도 불구하고 분리되기 전 표시과목이 표시된 자격증을 교부한다. 이 경우 교부된 자격증은 제1항에 따라 분리된 표시과목이 표시된 자격증으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 1, when issuing a certificate to a person who is currently undergoing a teacher training course at the time of the enforcement of this Rule and has completed a subject corresponding to the subject designated prior to separation, a certificate indicating the subject designated prior to separation shall be issued. In this case, the issued certificate shall be deemed to be a certificate indicating the separated subject designation pursuant to Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 또는 제2항에 따라 분리되기 전 표시과목이 표시된 자격증을 소지한 사람은 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 소정의 연수를 받아야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Persons holding a certificate with a subject indicated prior to separation pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2 must undergo prescribed training as determined by the Minister of Education.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(서식 개정에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 따른 서식은 이 규칙 시행 이후 3개월 동안 이 규칙에 따른 서식과 함께 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Transitional Measures Regarding Amendment of Forms)  Forms under the previous regulations at the time of enforcement of this rule may be used together with the forms under this rule for three months after enforcement of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(자격증의 정정) ① 교육부장관은 부칙 제3조에 따라 표시과목이 “요업”인 자격증을 소지한 사람이 자격증의 정정을 신청하는 경우에는 명칭이 변경된 “세라믹”표시과목으로 자격증을 정정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Correction of Certificates) ① Where a person holding a certificate indicating “Ceramic Industry” applies for correction under Article 3 of these Addenda, the Minister of Education shall correct the subject designation to the renamed subject “Ceramics”.

rows.source_ko: ② 교육부장관은 부칙 제4조제3항에 따라 연수를 받은 사람이 자격증의 정정을 신청하는 경우에는 분리된 표시과목으로 자격증을 정정하여야 한다. 이 경우 표시과목이 “자원ㆍ환경”으로 표시된 자격증을 소지한 사람은 “자원”과 “환경공업” 중에서 하나의 표시과목을 선택하여 자격증의 정정을 신청하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② In cases where a person who has received training pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 3 of the Addenda applies for the correction of a certificate, the Minister of Education shall correct the certificate to a separated subject. In this case, a person holding a certificate with the subject indicated as “Resources and Environment” must apply for the correction of the certificate by selecting one subject from “Resources” and “Environmental Industry.”

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning Subjects with Changed Names)  ① Qualification certificates designated as Commerce pursuant to the former Annex 1 prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed as qualification certificates designated as Business and Finance subjects pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 1.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행 당시 교직과정을 이수 중인 사람 중 종전의 별표 1에 따라 상업에 해당하는 과목을 이수한 사람에 대하여 자격증을 발급하는 경우에는 별표 1의 개정규정에도 불구하고 상업 과목이 표시된 자격증을 발급한다. 이 경우 발급된 자격증은 제1항에 따라 경영ㆍ금융 과목이 표시된 자격증으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② In cases where a certificate is issued to persons who are undergoing a teaching course at the time of the enforcement of this Rule and have completed subjects corresponding to commerce in accordance with the former Annex 1, a certificate indicating commerce subjects shall be issued notwithstanding the amended provisions of Annex 1.
